name: Receive while the mint is unreachable (credits after recovery)
description: The wallet tries to redeem a 10-sat ecash token while the mint is unreachable. Instead of losing the token, it records the receive as pending, and once the mint comes back the money is credited automatically.
details: Fund 20 testnut sats (net 19), then arm an offline rule on testnut /v1/swap and paste a fresh cocod 10-sat token: redeeming is a recoverable network failure, so the wallet must record a pending receive (pendingReason network) instead of losing the token. Clearing the rule lets the receive recover and credit automatically: +10 minus the 1-sat testnut redeem fee lands the wallet on 28 (delta +10 with a 1-sat fee envelope). Fresh-wallet variant: testnut is an unknown mint, so the first redeem opens the trust review (proven legs from receive.cashu.unknown-mint); trust is granted against the live /v1/info (un-faulted) and the SECOND redeem hits the faulted swap

optional.reason: android has no blocking paste dialog
